summary: Backend and full-stack engineer with 9 years of shipping products — Python and TypeScript services on PostgreSQL and Redis, REST APIs, and the React/Angular frontends in front of them. I've built real-time pipelines that ingest and replay external live data feeds, and I currently architect and run the platform behind Slovakia's national e-government, so I take API design, data modelling, monitoring and security remediation as one job rather than three.

experience.name: NASES — National e-Government Platform
bullets: Architect the platform behind slovensko.sk and work daily with the backend teams building on it — API and service design, PostgreSQL/Oracle data layers, Kafka messaging and end-to-end monitoring.
Own secrets management (Vault), identity and OAuth (Keycloak), and the vulnerability-scanning and remediation loop enforced in the shared CI pipelines.
Build the internal developer platform (Kubernetes/OpenShift, Terraform, GitLab CI, Argo CD) used by teams across the organisation.

experience.name: LiveAgent
bullets: Six years building a help-desk SaaS used by tens of thousands of companies: backend feature work and architecture (PHP, Java, Python) plus the JavaScript frontend, on MariaDB, Redis and Elasticsearch — including diagnosing customer-reported UI bugs and performance regressions in the browser.
Ran the AWS infrastructure behind it (Terraform), including caching, search and background workers; two years on the leadership team, mentoring engineers and running hiring.

experience.name: Lapz
bullets: Co-founded a spatial Formula 1 companion app for Apple Vision Pro and owned all real-time telemetry: ingesting external live data feeds and building the processing, buffering and playback pipeline that drove the visualisation (Python, Swift).

experience.name: ViaJet
bullets: Co-founded and built a B2B2C private-jet charter marketplace end to end — Python backend, PostgreSQL schema design, search with faceted filtering and the booking flow, TypeScript frontend.

experience.name: DXC Technology
bullets: Delivered an internal race-organisation web application on a two-person team — Angular frontend against a Python (Flask) API on MySQL, containerised with Docker and deployed to Azure.
